assignments.node_id: על־ידי שמצמצם אור התלהבות לבו, שלא יתלהב יותר מדי, כדי שיוכל לעבד את השם יתברך בהדרגה ובמדה. ומקדש את מחשבתו לבלי לחשב שום מחשבות רעות, רק לחשב תמיד מחשבות קדושות. שהם בחינת יצר טוב, בחינת חכמה שבלב. שעל־ידי־זה מציר המדות טובות, וזוכה לעשות פעלות ומעשים טובים ומדות טובות
assignments.reason: This is a compound-summary node describing the entire process of tzimtzum of the heart's flame + sanctifying thought + chokhma shebalev → good midot. Its essential nature is the avodah-of-the-heart: contracting the lahavut, guarding machshava, and activating chokhma shebalev. It explicitly mentions 'בחינת חכמה שבלב' and 'יצר טוב' — both core members of the proposed lev/chokhma-of-heart package. This IS the heart's creative process described from the practical side.

assignments.node_id: בינה
assignments.reason: In Torah 49 §ד, Binah is identified as 'בינה לבא' — Binah IS the heart (binah = liba). It is the beita ilaa (upper house) that corresponds to the heart in its higher aspect. The Torah explicitly states 'בינה לבא — היא בחינת ביתא עלאה' (line 20). Binah's essential nature in this Torah is the supernal dimension of the heart itself, making it a member of the heart/chokhma-shebalev domain.

assignments.node_id: ביתא עלאה
assignments.reason: Beita Ilaa (Upper House) = Binah = Liba (heart) in Torah 49 §ד (line 20). Its essential nature is the supernal heart — the upper dimension of the chalal panui. Torah 49 teaches that the beita ilaa IS the beginning of the tzimtzum, the empty space in the heart where creation happens (line 34). It belongs to the heart/creation domain, not to the Malkhut domain (which is beita tataa).

assignments.node_id: גאולה
assignments.reason: Geula (redemption) is mentioned in Torah 49 §ו (line 49/54) in direct connection with teshuva: 'גדולה תשובה שמקרבת הגאולה' and 'בניסן עתידין לגאל... ואין הגאולה אלא על ידי תשובה.' Geula's essential nature in this Torah is the eschatological arrival that results from teshuva. It is part of the Shabbat/Teshuva/future-world domain — the telos of the teshuva process.

assignments.node_id: כשיוצאין ישראל מחכמתן של האמות
assignments.reason: This node describes Israel leaving the wisdom of the nations (§ז, line 72-73). Its essential nature is the purification of chokhma — leaving external/foreign wisdom and returning to holy chokhma shebalev. In the Torah's argument, the nations' wisdom contaminates the heart's chokhma; leaving it restores the heart's clarity. This belongs to the chokhma/heart domain as the act of purifying the heart's wisdom from foreign contamination.

assignments.node_id: הצדיק יוצא מהחפה והמכסה שהיה לו עד עכשו
assignments.reason: This node describes the tzaddik emerging from his covering/canopy (§ז, line 74). Its essential nature is the tzaddik's revelation — the sun-tzaddik breaking free from concealment. The additions file identifies the bechina pair צדיק=שמש for this Torah (line 70). This node IS the tzaddik in his moment of re-emergence, belonging to the tzaddik/shemesh domain.

assignments.node_id: זריזות גדול בעבודתו יתברך, ולרוץ מאד מאד
assignments.reason: Zerizut (great urgency in serving God, running very fast) is described in lines 101-103 as a direct consequence and expression of teshuva. After doing teshuva, one must run with great zerizut to make up for the lost time. Its essential nature IS teshuva in its urgent-practical mode — the running to repair is itself part of the teshuva process. The Torah frames this as 'after one merits to awaken to teshuva, one needs great zerizut.'

assignments.node_id: לתקן ולהשלים גם חסרון העבודה של הימים שעברו.
assignments.reason: This node describes 'repairing and completing the deficiency of service from past days' (line 103). Its essential nature IS teshuva — specifically the retroactive repair dimension of teshuva, making up for what was lost. This is teshuva's defining function: returning to fill the gap. It belongs squarely in the Shabbat/Teshuva domain.

assignments.node_id: צריכין לשמר מחשבתו מאד, ולהכריח עצמו תמיד לחשוב מחשבות טובות, שהם בחינת יצר טוב
assignments.reason: This node describes guarding one's thought and forcing oneself to think good thoughts = yetzer tov (line 37). Its essential nature is machshava/chokhma shebalev — the active guarding of the heart's wisdom. The node explicitly identifies itself as 'בחינת יצר טוב' which is a core member of the proposed lev package (additions: machshavot tovot = yetzer tov).

assignments.node_id: מעשים טובים ומדות טובות וכו, ולהתפלל בכונה ולעשות תשובה
assignments.reason: This compound node includes 'good deeds and good midot, and to pray with kavana and to do teshuva' (line 37). Its essential nature is the revelatory result of the heart's work — the midot tovot that reveal Malkhut. The proof text for edge 7 explicitly says 'כי תפלה שבלב היא בחינת התגלות מלכותו' — this IS the manifestation of Malkhut through tefilla and midot. While it mentions teshuva, the dominant nature is tefilla/Malkhut revelation.

assignments.node_id: שזוכה לפעלות ומדות טובות
assignments.reason: This node 'meriting good deeds and good midot' (line 32) is the direct vehicle for revealing Malkhut. The Torah states explicitly (line 32): 'על ידי שזוכה לפעלות ומדות טובות... מקבל עליו על מלכות שמים שלמה, שזהו בחינת התגלות מלכותו.' The pe'ulot/midot ARE the revelation of Malkhut — their essential nature is Malkhut-manifested-through-action.

assignments.node_id: מקבל עליו על מלכות שמים שלמה
assignments.reason: Accepting the yoke of the Kingdom of Heaven in full (line 11/32) IS Malkhut — this is the quintessential expression of Malkhut's revelation. The Torah equates this explicitly: 'מקבל עליו על מלכות שמים שלמה שזהו בחינת התגלות מלכותו.' Its essential nature is Malkhut itself, the achieved state of divine kingship being accepted.

assignments.node_id: כשאדם חושב מחשבות טובות בלבו איך לעבד את השם יתברך
assignments.reason: This node describes 'when a person thinks good thoughts in his heart about how to serve God' (line 11). Its essential nature is machshavot tovot shebalev — the very act of thinking holy thoughts in the heart, which is the core definition of chokhma shebalev/yetzer tov in this Torah. It belongs to the heart/chokhma domain.

assignments.node_id: נעשה לבו, בבחינת: "צור לבבי", ובבחינת: "ולבי חלל בקרבי", שבתוך החלל יתגלו פעלותיו
assignments.reason: This node describes the heart becoming 'tzur levavi' and 'libi chalal bekirbi' — the heart as sculptor and the chalal panui within (line 11). Its essential nature IS the heart/chalal-panui in its activated state. It explicitly contains both 'צור לבבי' and 'חלל' which are core nodes of the proposed lev package.

assignments.node_id: וצריך לצמצם ההתלהבות, כדי שישאר בעל־ידי שמצמצם אור התלהבות לבו, שלא יתלהב יותר מדי, כדי שיוכל לעבד את השם יתברך בהדרגה ובמדה. ומקדש את מחשבתו לבלי לחשב שום מחשבות רעות, רק לחשב תמיד מחשבות קדושות. שהם בחינת יצר טוב, בחינת חכמה שבלב. שעל־ידי־זה מציר המדות טובות, וזוכה לעשות פעלות ומעשים טובים ומדות טובותלב חלל,
assignments.reason: This is a variant/extended version of the tzimtzum-of-the-heart node (appears to be a data entry variant of the first node). It describes contracting the lahavut so that the heart remains chalal, then activating chokhma shebalev. Its essential nature is the heart's creative tzimtzum process — the same lev/chokhma-shebalev domain.

assignments.node_id: עולה גם ביתא עלאה
assignments.reason: This node describes 'the beita ilaa also ascends' (line 22). It is the ascent-state of beita ilaa = Binah = liba (heart). Its essential nature is the supernal heart in its elevated state. Like 'ביתא עלאה' itself, it belongs to the heart/chokhma domain as the upper dimension of the heart.

assignments.node_id: כשחושב מחשבות טובות
assignments.reason: This node 'when one thinks good thoughts — this is chokhma shebalev' (line 31, with node_text explicitly saying 'שזהו בחינת חכמה שבלב'). Its essential nature IS chokhma shebalev — the node self-identifies as such. It belongs to the heart/chokhma domain.

assignments.node_id: פעלות ומדות טובות
assignments.reason: Pe'ulot u-midot tovot (good deeds and good traits) — line 31 — are the revealed expression of Malkhut. The Torah explicitly states (line 32): 'בריאת העולמות ועבודת השם בפעולות ומדות טובות הם בחינה אחת ממש' — and the purpose of the worlds = Malkhut revelation. The pe'ulot are the content of Malkhut's manifestation. Their essential nature is Malkhut-in-action.

assignments.node_id: צריך האדם לצמצם אור התלהבות לבו
assignments.reason: This node 'a person must contract the light of his heart's flame' (line 27) describes the tzimtzum of the heart, which is the foundational act that creates the chalal panui in the heart. Its essential nature is the heart's self-discipline — the act of creating space for chokhma. It belongs to the heart domain.

assignments.node_id: שיוכל לעבד את השם בהדרגה ובמדה
assignments.reason: This node 'so that one can serve God gradually and in measure' (line 27) describes the telos of the tzimtzum: structured avodat Hashem. Its essential nature is avodah/tefilla — the service that reveals Malkhut. The Torah teaches that this measured service IS what manifests the midot and reveals Malkhut (§ב: 'עבודה שבלב זה תפלה'). Service-in-measure is the Malkhut/prayer domain.

assignments.node_id: שעקר עבודת השם, לזכות למדות ומעשים טובים,
assignments.reason: This node 'the essence of serving God is to merit good traits and good deeds' (line 30). Its essential nature is the telos of avodah which IS Malkhut revelation. The proof text (line 30) continues: 'הוא על ידי ששומר החכמה שבלב' — but the node itself states the goal (midot/ma'asim tovim = Malkhut revelation), not the means (chokhma shebalev). The essence of this node IS the purpose of service = Malkhut.

assignments.node_id: ששומר החכמה שבלב, שהוא המחשבה שבלב. שצריכין לשמר מאד המחשבה שבלב, שהוא בחינת חכמת לב, שזהו עקר היצרין
assignments.reason: This node describes 'guarding the chokhma shebalev, which is the machshava shebalev, which is chokhmat lev, which is the essence of the yetzarim' (line 30). Its essential nature is explicitly chokhma shebalev — it self-identifies multiple times as chokhma/machshava shebalev. This IS the core concept of the lev package.

assignments.node_id: תפלה תלוי בלב, שישים כל לבו עליה
assignments.reason: This node 'prayer depends on the heart, that one place one's whole heart upon it' (line 14) describes tefilla in its heart-dependent aspect. While it mentions the heart, its essential nature IS tefilla — the statement that prayer's essence is wholeheartedness. The proof text (§ב) continues: 'תפלה שבלב היא בחינת התגלות מלכותו' — prayer-in-the-heart IS Malkhut revealed. Tefilla is already a core node of Package 1.
